experimental_runs_note: 5 records reproduce a claimed violation (L5), 0 are two-revision verified (L6); 18 distinct proof runs; 127 records carry an admitted execution artefact. V3.2 execution overlay: 127 candidates carry a run artefact (18 distinct proof runs: 12 successful, 1 test_failed, 5 blocked; levels from committed reports/v3/experimental_proof.json and reports/v3/compile_sweep.json via scripts/v32_execution.py). `evidence_admitted_records` counts L3-or-above admitted records (compile-or-run artefact present), not reproduced vulnerabilities. L5 requires a structured, claim-specific violation_evidence record (impact type, actor, property, expected vs observed, source); attacker profit is mandatory only for fund_theft. L6 is never awarded (no candidate has a fixed-side leg). Every other record keeps the L0/L1 its source supports.

run_accounting_definitions.blocked_executions: Proof runs recorded with status `blocked` (pruned RPC, unreplayable state, timeout): they never reached a comparable test outcome and prove nothing.
run_accounting_definitions.candidate_artefacts: Rows of the pre-admission candidate ledger (7712 rows) that carry an `experiment` artefact, so this counts candidates, not admitted records and not proof runs; a compile-only sweep row counts here.
run_accounting_definitions.evidence_admitted_records: Admitted V3 records (5467 in the population) whose verification_level is one of L3/L4/L5/L6, i.e. an admitted compile-or-run artefact exists; this is NOT a count of reproduced vulnerabilities: 5 record(s) are L5 (a claimed violation observed with claim-specific evidence) and 0 are L6 (two-revision verified).
run_accounting_definitions.execution_attempts: Distinct proof runs listed in reports/v3/experimental_proof.json (18), each run id accounted exactly once, so this counts runs, not records.
run_accounting_definitions.failed_executions: Proof runs recorded with status `test_failed`: the test executed and did not pass.
run_accounting_definitions.successful_executions: Proof runs that reached a comparable test outcome with test rc=0; a run without attacker-side profit evidence sits here and stays at L4.
